adoptedConstraints: All 213 validated unchanged-boundary seat transitions form the historical frame; the Stage 13 identity sample does not select contests.
All standing candidates and noncandidate ballot destinations share one accounting ledger. Cancelled contests are visible but not scored.
Candidate identity, status and Stage 8-11 operational effects remain unresolved/null; unknown does not mean zero.
Target candidate votes, winner flags and target split destination cells are evaluation-only.
No 2026 candidate baseline or national-support forecast is available in this checkpoint.

conditionalHistorical.label: retrospective conditional candidate allocation diagnostic
inputs: observed target local party-vote group sizes from independently published party results
observed target informal-party and turnout controls if used, separately labelled
target candidature as reconstructed from official post-election records, with historical as-of status unknown
conditionalHistorical.interpretation: Candidate-allocation diagnostic conditional on realized target party/turnout information; not a pre-election forecast.

preElectionForecast.label: genuine as-of candidate-vote forecast, presently input-blocked
preElectionForecast.cutoffRule: official target nomination-close timestamp for every historical holdout, source-pinned before any scoring; exact dates not currently pinned
requiredAsOfInputs: dated target nominations and party ballot groups
national and local party support forecast with uncertainty
valid/informal/disallowed party and candidate ballot rates or bounds
candidate mapping and routing evidence available by cutoff
preElectionForecast.interpretation: May be called a forecast only when every input is demonstrably pre-cutoff and every ballot group has a feasible, explicit destination rule or a declared abstention.

nationalSupportScenario.label: externally supplied national-support scenario, not a national forecast
requiredInputs: separately supplied turnout and ballot-validity assumptions
nationalSupportScenario.interpretation: Conditional scenario calculation; Stage 5 historical diagnostics use observed target national support and do not supply an as-of scenario.

recommendedBaseline.name: training-only pooled party-destination interval ledger
recommendedBaseline.estimand: For each held contest, a jointly feasible range for every standing candidate's valid candidate votes and the valid-candidate denominator, conditional on the declared party-ballot and turnout input mode.
recommendedBaseline.source: Pool earlier general-seat split rows across seats within the source election by party-ballot group and destination PARTY CATEGORY, using exact row counts and rounded-percentage intervals. Do not use a seat-specific outgoing candidate column or interval midpoint as an exact observation. Pooling is deterministic and training-only; absent party categories remain unknown.
routing: Define one ballot-mass group for every party-vote group, the informal-party group and the unrepresented/disallowed-party remainder from common votes cast.
Define destinations for every standing candidate plus candidate-informal and no-valid-candidate/party-only outcomes; unknown destinations remain feasible rather than receiving zero votes.

Map pooled destination-party categories to the unique standing target candidate of that continuing party. This is a population party-category allocation assumption, not a same-person assertion or transfer of one outgoing candidate’s seat-specific strength.

If the source or target party is an entrant/exit, ambiguous/report-only alliance, or the target has no unique candidate of that party, keep that source or target mass in an unconstrained joint routing set.

Independents and candidates with no matching party-ballot group remain target destinations for ballots from every group, including informal/disallowed-party; no independent-to-independent name matching is inferred.

A source destination party absent in the target is not renormalized onto survivors; its mass enters the unresolved routing set. A same-party replacement uses the pooled category rule only; no outgoing-person premium is carried forward.

Each group has nonnegative route fractions summing to one. Preserve the full feasible set, including source rounding intervals, missing group mass, turnout and validity bounds. Contest-wide candidate bounds are marginal projections, not jointly attainable endpoints.

A point candidate prediction is unavailable when the feasible candidate-vote range is nondegenerate; retain interval/bounds and point-abstention status. A candidate with unknown history is never assigned zero strength.
recommendedBaseline.denominators: Total cast ballots are partitioned into valid party, informal party and party-disallowed/unrepresented groups. Valid candidate votes equal the sum of all named-candidate destinations, including candidate-only contributions from informal/disallowed-party groups. Published candidate share divides by this valid-candidate total, not valid party votes or split-row totals. If valid-candidate total can be zero, candidate-share interval is undefined and abstains.
recommendedBaseline.maori: Keep Māori separate. The 2020 supporting local matrix is one seat/year only; without a comparable local panel and assembled full party groups, do not force local routing or a coefficient. Preserve a wide feasible ledger or abstain.
recommendedBaseline.poolingRule: For each source-election party-ballot group g and destination party/noncandidate category h, sum exact source row mass n_r times each rounded-cell probability lower/upper endpoint across eligible earlier general seats, then divide by sum n_r. Retain row-sum feasibility and an envelope of source-seat heterogeneity; if total eligible n_r is zero, the route is unknown. A category absent in the target retains a feasible unknown destination, never a redistributed point.
recommendedBaseline.shareBounds: Compute candidate-vote/valid-candidate-vote ratio extrema over the SAME joint feasible ballot ledger (a linear-fractional feasibility problem), not by dividing independent marginal endpoints. If the valid-candidate denominator can be zero, return undefined/abstain.
recommendedBaseline.inputVectorConservation: Forecast or scenario party group masses plus informal and disallowed/unrepresented mass must equal the supplied votes-cast total or a jointly feasible turnout interval. Independently transformed Stage 5 party shares are not silently normalized or clipped to repair a broken vector.

comparators.name: party-diagonal interval accounting
comparators.purpose: Tests whether historical local splitting adds information
comparators.rule: A valid party group with a unique same-party candidate takes the diagonal as a prespecified simplifying assumption; informal/disallowed party groups, unmatched/absent destinations and other candidates remain explicit unknown mass. It may abstain from an exact total.

comparators.name: unrestricted feasible ballot ledger
comparators.purpose: Tests whether pooling adds interval information rather than merely producing broad valid bounds
comparators.rule: Every group can route to every standing candidate or noncandidate destination subject only to nonnegative mass conservation; report sharpness and interval coverage, not a competitive point score.

deferredComparator: Stage 11's unimplemented probable-continuation candidate-share carry-forward sensitivity may be evaluated later only on a separately justified identity/geography subset, never used to select or score this checkpoint. A local source-seat split transfer is also a separately labelled sensitivity because it may carry the outgoing candidate’s seat-specific strength to a replacement; do not use it as this identity-free baseline.

validationFreezeProposal.frame: The 213 saved source/target seat-transition clusters; 212 held both, one 2023 Port Waikato cancelled/unheld. Every target candidature in a held contest belongs to coverage accounting regardless of identity, party or result.
validationFreezeProposal.training: For target year h, source routing and any pooled/fallback parameter use elections strictly before h. No target-year split cells or candidate outcomes train h. The 2011 holdout may use 2008 source rows; any parameter needing an earlier target transition is unavailable and must abstain.
validationFreezeProposal.cutoff: Nomination close is the intended common as-of cutoff. No exact date is pinned yet; strict prospective historical scoring is blocked until dated inputs are audited.
validationFreezeProposal.samples: Fix full eligible contest/candidate frame first. Report each model's coverage/abstention on it, then point-error metrics on the exact intersection of model and comparator predictions. Interval diagnostics use a separately declared common interval subset; never choose a favourable subset by outcomes.
validationFreezeProposal.metrics: For point valid-candidate votes and percentage-point candidate shares, equal candidate-event MAE=mean absolute error, RMSE=square root mean squared error, bias=mean signed error; n is the identical candidate intersection. Report contest-weighted sensitivity separately, not as an implicit weight change. For joint intervals report exact-target inclusion, mean and median interval width, nondegenerate/undefined denominator count, and feasible ballot-mass conservation. Report counts and rates of point and interval abstention over the full eligible frame and common subset, including entrants, independents, replacements/unknown identity and losers. Give holdout, general/Māori and party/status breakdowns where supported; avoid election-level iid claims from candidate counts.
validationFreezeProposal.selection: No operational point baseline is selected unless all required as-of inputs and coherent candidate/ballot routing exist, its point coverage is nontrivial on the prespecified frame, and both later chronological holdouts show stable improvement against the party-diagonal benchmark on identical point samples and the unrestricted-ledger interval baseline for sharpness/coverage on identical samples without material calibration or mass-accounting failures. Do not infer operational choice from conditional diagnostics or an attractive coefficient. If complete point allocation remains unsupported, keep selection null/unresolved and report interval coverage and abstention.
validationFreezeProposal.stopping: Stop scoring attempts if target input timing is unverified, a group cannot be bounded coherently, candidate-share denominator can be zero without an explicit undefined state, or a common comparison sample cannot be formed. Preserve uncertainty; do not invent a fallback to remove abstentions.

conditionalStage6Review: Separate later NAT/LAB general-seat common frame and information set: compare a jointly estimated conditional response with beta=1/zero and the identity-free baseline on identical holdouts and party-input modes. Retain Stage 5 additive/proportional/log-odds and D027 0.25pp materiality/stability guard; unknown identity/status stays unknown, not continuation, and Stage 10 descriptive shift is not fixed. No Stage 6 refit or target-boundary baseline is performed here.

all standing candidate occurrence IDs and noncandidate destination IDs
joint route constraints and unresolved mass reasons
candidate vote and valid-candidate denominator bounds

common-sample membership, benchmark ID and evaluation-only actuals in separate scoring output
